title: ATLAS-Bench: An Agentic Tool-Use Benchmark for Local Area Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.39438v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable local search is essential for LLM agents to support everyday decisions and longer plans by finding places that meet users' needs at given times and locations. Yet existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of whether search results satisfy mandatory requirements, account for preferences, and ground factual and experiential judgments in place attributes and reviews. We introduce ATLAS-Bench, a benchmark of 1,200 queries across three regions, expanded from real search events using place attributes, reviews, and existing user profiles from the platform. Each query distinguishes mandatory requirements from preferences and factual conditions from subjective judgments, with supporting evidence and criteria for checking each requirement. translated_title: ATLAS-Bench：一个面向本地区域搜索的智能体工具使用基准
translated_abstract: 可靠的本地搜索对于大语言模型（LLM）智能体至关重要，它通过在给定时间和地点找到满足用户需求的场所，来支持日常决策和长期规划。然而，现有基准测试在以下方面的覆盖有限：搜索结果是否满足强制性要求、是否考虑用户偏好，以及是否将事实性和体验性判断建立在场所属性和评论的基础上。我们提出了ATLAS-Bench，这是一个涵盖三个地区共1,200个查询的基准测试，它从真实搜索事件出发，利用场所属性、评论以及平台上现有的用户画像进行扩展。每个查询都区分了强制性要求与用户偏好，以及事实性条件与主观判断，并为检查每项要求提供了支持性证据和评判标准。所有查询均通过迭代断言检查和跨模型审查进行验证。我们还引入了ATLASBox，这是一个标准化的评估环境，配备了搜索工具和固定的兴趣点（POI）数据。
tldr: 本文提出了ATLAS-Bench——一个包含跨三个地区1,200个查询的智能体工具使用基准，用于评估LLM智能体在本地搜索中区分并满足强制性要求、用户偏好以及事实性与主观判断的能力，并配套提供标准化评估环境ATLASBox。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ATLAS-Bench, an agentic tool-use benchmark of 1,200 queries across three regions for evaluating LLM agents' local area search capabilities, distinguishing mandatory requirements from preferences and factual from subjective judgments, accompanied by a standardized evaluation environment called ATLASBox.
